answers.sql: SELECT (CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'P2' THEN transfer_volume END) AS REAL) - CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'P1' THEN transfer_volume END) AS REAL)) / CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'P1' THEN transfer_volume END) AS REAL) * 100.0 FROM exports;

SELECT (CAST((SELECT SUM(amount_units) FROM events WHERE period = 'P2' AND event_kind NOT IN ('mint', 'burn')) AS REAL) / CAST((SELECT SUM(amount_units) FROM events WHERE period = 'P1' AND event_kind NOT IN ('mint', 'burn')) AS REAL) - 1.0) * 100.0;
